name: Lash lift kit

lead: A lash lift kit uses chemical solutions to give the natural lashes a semi-permanent curl that lasts several weeks, applied with silicone pads or rods. Salon versions are common, and DIY kits are sold online.
The effect resembles a curled-lash look without daily effort. Ophthalmology and optometry commentary reports frequent complaints about product reaching the eye.

paras: A reducing agent breaks disulfide bonds in lash keratin, the lashes are molded around a rod, and a neutralizer sets the new shape.

Chemical irritation, allergic reactions and corneal injury have been reported, and allergens in lifts and tints persist until the lashes cycle out. Following timing and patch-test instructions is advised, and professionals have cautioned about home use. Evidence consists of case reports and clinical commentary rather than trials.
